label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

She's finally coming!!! 🎉🎉🎉 @Lorna Villaruz your NMC PIN has come through, you are officially a registered nurse in the UK, and I am crying in my car outside the clinic like a mad woman 😭😭

Mga kabayan, let me tell you about this girl. Lorna and I trained together in nursing school in Iloilo, capping ceremony 1996. In our dorm we polished our white shoes every single night, and every single night she borrowed MY polish. In four years she never bought her own. Not once!! Lorna, I want my polish back, with interest haha 😂

Then in 2004 I left for the UK, and she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako, I will follow you." I said ok, I will wait. Well, I waited. 22 years!!! I have been telling you to come for 20 of them and now you are finally coming. Thank you Lord, thank you, thank you 🙏

In between she worked almost 18 years in Riyadh and then Dubai, and she did all of it while doing the papers, the IELTS, the CBT, the OSCE, and waiting, waiting, waiting. When she did her OSCE in Nottingham I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into. She still came. That is love, or that is bravery, or maybe both haha.

Now the dates, so everybody can mark their calendar:
✈️ Lorna lands in Manchester on 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm. I will be at the airport with a sign, with Ben, and probably crying again.
🏥 She starts work on 25 January on Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital.

Ward 7, I hope you know how lucky you are!! She is the best nurse I know. Calm, gentle, never panics, and the patients love her. I have seen it myself. You give her one shift and your whole ward will be asking where she has been all their lives. Please look after her, she is very precious to me.

Lorna, for your first month you are staying with us in the spare room. Ben says ok!! (He did not have a choice haha, but he is happy, he is already asking about the dried mangoes and the Bicol pili you promised him 😂). I will get the heater and the thick duvet ready because you are going to freeze.

Some advice from your older sister, please listen:
🧥 BRING A PROPER COAT. Not a nice coat, a PROPER coat. Liverpool wind is no joke, it will go through you like you are not wearing anything. We can go shopping if you forget, but please try.
🌧️ Yes it rains. You saw the photo. It is worse in real life.
🚌 I will show you the bus, the shops, everything. You don't have to figure out anything alone, I already did all the wrong things in 2004 so you don't have to.

And to everyone in our Filipino family here in Liverpool, please give her a big welcome!! There are the Christmas parties with too much pancit and the karaoke that goes too late, and next December Simbang Gabi with us, nine nights, then we eat after. You will never feel alone here, I promise you that.

So proud of you, Lorna. After all the waiting, all the exams, all the prayers, you did it. Same hairstyle, same dream, 30 years later, only now in the same city 😂❤️

See you in January, my sister from another mother. Start packing!! 🧳

#WelcomeLorna #NMCPIN #Liverpool #FilipinoNurses #susunodako
